# Source of dragonslayer.aseprite and dragonslayer.png (python tools/sprite/sprite.py build <this> dragonslayer.aseprite).
# Dragonslayer: the Humans' boss, the drakelings' worst nightmare. Dark plate 3a4466/262b44 with gold trim, a great
# helm crowned with bone dragon horns ecd8b1/d5bf9b and one glowing eye fee761, red tabard and torn cape
# a22633/e43b44/5d1d2c, a two-handed greatsword. Same 40x40 canvas as the Broodmother. Generated by
# tools/sprite/parts/humans_big.py. Marches with the sword on the shoulder, a two-handed overhead cleave,
# falls to one knee and then on its back. OATH raises the sword and it flares gold (Slayer's Oath); SWEEP is
# the last stand's cleave, one flat swing all the way round.
size = 40x40
